name: 17 squares in a unit square
description: The smallest square containing 17 unit squares, read the other way round: the arena is a unit square, so a common scale s means the shapes can be of side s, and the box being minimised has side 1/s. The solution loaded by default is that same published packing, scaled by 1/s and moved into this arena's frame; it scores exactly what the direct reading of the instance scores, which is the point of the pair.
